tools.name: ask-kimi
tools.description: Execute Kimi Code CLI with file analysis (@syntax), session resume, MCP passthrough, and safety controls.

prompt.description: Task or question. Use @ to include files (e.g., '@largefile.ts explain').

model.description: Optional model override. Known: kimi-for-coding, kimi-k2-6, kimi-k2-6-turbo, kimi-k2-thinking-turbo, kimi-k2-5, kimi-latest. If omitted, uses your Kimi CLI default (~/.kimi/config.toml).

thinking.description: Toggle thinking mode (overrides default_thinking from config).

afk.description: --afk: auto-approve in away-from-keyboard mode (print mode implies this).

workingDir.description: Working directory for execution (alias of cd)

outputFormat.description: Kimi --output-format. "text" (default for clean responses) or "stream-json" (JSONL with assistant + tool messages).

finalOnly.description: Add --final-message-only — skip intermediate tool-call output. Default: true.

config.description: Configuration overrides — string (JSON/TOML) or object passed via --config.

configFile.description: Path to a config file (TOML or JSON).

mcpConfigFile.description: Path to an MCP config file with `mcpServers` (passed via --mcp-config-file).

skillsDirs.description: Custom skills directories (--skills-dir, repeatable). Overrides default discovery.

agent.description: Builtin agent spec to use (--agent). "default" or "okabe".

maxRalphIterations.description: Extra autonomous iterations after the first turn (--max-ralph-iterations, -1 = unlimited).

plan.description: Start in plan mode (--plan). For richer planning, prefer the plan-kimi tool.

sessionId.description: Internal session ID for conversation continuity (workspace-isolated).

resetSession.description: Clear session context before execution. Starts fresh conversation.

continueLatest.description: Use --continue to resume the most recent Kimi session in cwd.

includeMetadata.description: Include tool-call metadata in response (only meaningful with stream-json).

responseMode.description: Response verbosity: "clean" returns only the final answer (default), "full" includes tool calls and stderr execution log.

dryRun.description: Return the resolved CLI argv as JSON without spawning Kimi.

tools.name: batch-kimi
tools.description: Delegate multiple atomic tasks to Kimi for batch processing. Ideal for repetitive operations, mass refactoring, and automated transformations.

tasks.description: Array of atomic tasks to delegate to Kimi

model.description: Optional model override applied to every task. Known: kimi-for-coding, kimi-k2-6, kimi-k2-6-turbo, kimi-k2-thinking-turbo, kimi-k2-5, kimi-latest.

concurrency.description: Maximum parallel Kimi processes when parallel=true. Default: min(task count, 4)

stopOnError.description: Stop execution if any task fails

timeout.description: Maximum execution time per task in milliseconds

tools.name: review-changes
tools.description: Run a code review against the current repository using Kimi (collects git diff + structured review prompt).

prompt.description: Custom review instructions or focus areas (optional)

uncommitted.description: Review staged + unstaged + untracked changes (working tree)

base.description: Review changes against a specific base branch (e.g., "main", "develop")

commit.description: Review changes introduced by a specific commit SHA

title.description: Optional title for the review summary

model.description: Optional model override. Known: kimi-for-coding, kimi-k2-6, kimi-k2-6-turbo, kimi-k2-thinking-turbo, kimi-k2-5, kimi-latest. If omitted, uses your Kimi CLI default.

thinking.description: Enable thinking mode for deeper review (recommended).

workingDir.description: Working directory to run the review in

tools.name: brainstorm
tools.description: Generate creative ideas using structured frameworks with domain context and feasibility analysis.

model.description: Optional model override. Known: kimi-for-coding, kimi-k2-6, kimi-k2-6-turbo, kimi-k2-thinking-turbo, kimi-k2-5, kimi-latest. If omitted, uses your Kimi CLI default.

thinking.description: Enable thinking mode for deeper reasoning during ideation.

methodology.description: Framework: divergent, convergent, scamper, design-thinking, lateral, auto (default)

domain.description: Domain: software, business, creative, research, product, marketing, etc.

constraints.description: Limitations: budget, time, technical, legal, etc.

tools.name: bg-kimi
tools.description: Run Kimi CLI as a detached background task. Subactions: start (returns taskId), status, tail (log output), stop, remove, list. Use for long-running autonomous work — the MCP call returns immediately and you poll status later.

label.description: Human-readable label to identify this task later.

model.description: Optional model override. Known: kimi-for-coding, kimi-k2-6, kimi-k2-6-turbo, kimi-k2-thinking-turbo, kimi-k2-5, kimi-latest.

yolo.description: --yolo: auto-approve everything (default for bg tasks: afk; pass yolo for full power).

maxRalphIterations.description: Extra autonomous iterations after the first turn. -1 = unlimited.

lines.description: Lines to return from log tail.

tools.name: plan-kimi
tools.description: Generate a structured implementation plan using Kimi's --plan mode. Use BEFORE coding to get steps, files-to-touch, risks, and open questions. Distinct from ask-kimi: uses --plan flag (different system prompt) and parses structured output.

goal.description: What you want planned (a feature, refactor, investigation).

contextFiles.description: Paths/globs to include as @-references in the prompt.

constraints.description: Hard constraints (must-not-touch areas, style rules, deadlines).

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria the plan must satisfy.

format.description: Output shape. json (default) returns structured steps/risks; markdown returns a checklist.

tools.name: digest-kimi
tools.description: Ingest many files at once and answer a focused question. Uses Kimi's 262K context to swallow whole modules / docs that don't fit in the caller's context. Walks directories, filters by extension, truncates oversized files, caps total payload. Returns a concentrated brief.

question.description: Focused question to answer using the provided files (e.g., "explain auth flow", "find dead code").

paths.description: Files or directories to ingest. Directories are walked. Globs are NOT expanded — pass concrete paths.

extensions.description: Filter by extensions when walking dirs (e.g., [".ts", ".tsx"]). Default: all text-like files.

exclude.description: Substrings to exclude from paths (matched against relative path). Default: node_modules, .git, dist, build.

maxBytesPerFile.description: Truncate any single file above this size. Default: 200 KB.

maxTotalBytes.description: Stop adding files once the total payload exceeds this (Kimi context is ~262K tokens / ~1MB safe). Default: 8 MB.

shape.description: summary: 1-paragraph; detailed: structured deep-dive; qa: focused answer to the question.

tools.name: delegate-kimi
tools.description: Delegate an implementation task to Kimi in an isolated git worktree. Kimi runs autonomously (--yolo) on a fresh branch, optionally looping against a test command. Returns a taskId; later 'collect' to grab the diff. Safe: changes are sandboxed, caller reviews & applies.

action.description: start: spawn delegated task; status: check progress; collect: stop + return diff + cleanup option.

task.description: What Kimi should accomplish (required for action=start).

acceptanceCriteria.description: Bullet list of criteria the implementation must satisfy.

baseBranch.description: Branch/commit to base the worktree on (default: current HEAD of repo).

branchName.description: Name for the new branch in the worktree. Default: kimi/<random>.

autoTest.description: Shell command Kimi should run after editing to validate (e.g., "npm test"). If passed, Kimi is told to loop until it passes.

maxRalphIterations.description: Extra autonomous iterations (Ralph mode). Default 5 (use -1 for unlimited).

cleanup.description: On collect: also run `git worktree remove` after grabbing the diff.

tools.name: list-sessions
tools.description: List active conversation sessions with metadata, or manage them (delete/clear)

action.description: Action: list (default), delete (single session), clear (all sessions)

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check Kimi CLI installation, authentication, and session health

sessionId.description: Optional session ID to check specific session health

tools.name: metrics
tools.description: Expose Prometheus-formatted metrics for Kimi MCP server
